purpose: Shared anti-duplication reservations for Hays Botany chats and automations. Canonical manifest, durable queue/drafts, and curation-inbox state always outrank stale claims.

claims.release_when: Each taxon becomes durably represented in research-queue.json/research-drafts, becomes canonical, or is explicitly closed/held in the Joey reconciliation lane.
claims.notes: Known remaining San Marcos/Joey local queue. Myriophyllum heterophyllum has an existing range concern and should remain a hold/review target rather than be silently promoted.

claims.release_when: Taxonomy reconciliation is recorded in a durable research/reconciliation artifact or canonical state.
claims.notes: Reserved because the Joey/video lane already identified these as reconciliation cases.

claims.release_when: All six taxa are durably represented in research-queue.json and research-drafts, or the test batch is explicitly aborted.
claims.notes: Live test of the overnight high-throughput Scout protocol. Research-only; no curation-inbox or canonical installation. Durable Croton drafts and queue records were created successfully; temporary claim released.

claims.release_when: All six Euphorbia taxa are durably represented in research-queue.json and research-drafts, or the test is explicitly aborted.
claims.notes: Second live high-throughput Scout test. Euphorbia visual comparison set: snow-on-the-prairie, snow-on-the-mountain, wild/green/painted poinsettias, and David's spurge. Research-only. Durable drafts + queue records created successfully; temporary claim released.

claims.release_when: All six current Acanthaceae work items are durably represented in research-queue.json and research-drafts, or the test is explicitly aborted.
claims.notes: Third live high-throughput Scout test. Collision gate skipped canonical Ruellia drummondiana/humilis and taxonomy-reconciled Ruellia nudiflora/nudiflora var. nudiflora/occidentalis because current Kew folds the latter names into already-canonical Ruellia ciliatiflora. Batch refilled with unfinished Acanthaceae: Ruellia metziae, Justicia americana, Justicia pilosella, Dyschoriste linearis, Dicliptera brachiata, and Anisacanthus quadrifidus. Durable drafts + queue records created successfully; temporary claim released.

claims.release_when: All six Malvaceae taxa are durably represented in research-queue.json and research-drafts, or the test is explicitly aborted.
claims.notes: Fourth live high-throughput Scout test. Malvaceae comparison batch after Oenothera and Callirhoe candidates were skipped because concurrent/canonical state showed those lanes already handled them. Durable drafts + queue records created successfully; temporary claim released.

claims.release_when: All seven taxa become durably represented in research-queue.json and research-drafts, or the batch is explicitly aborted.
claims.notes: Fifth coherent Scout batch: unfinished Euphorbiaceae comparison set from current Master Plant Pool, centered on local Acalypha and Tragia. Research-only.

claims.release_when: Durable deep-review results are written for all six Croton taxa, or the batch is explicitly aborted.
claims.notes: High-throughput deep review of coherent Croton scout batch. Review-only; no curation-inbox or canonical promotion.

claims.release_when: Euphorbiaceae family recognition upgrade and Family Study Index reconciliation are durably written, or work is explicitly aborted.
claims.notes: Euphorbiaceae family recognition upgrade, durable research package, Family Study Index row, and 147-family visual-phase bookkeeping are written. Macro visual polish remains future work; species lanes remain independent.

claims.release_when: All four family modules, research packages, Family Study Index rows, and family visual index updates are durably written, or the batch is explicitly aborted.
claims.notes: Family/genus recognition only. Do not promote species; Schoenoplectus tabernaemontani remains in Joey reconciliation lane.
